transporte-publico.html.title: Where Can I Live? · Barcelona Housing, Commute & Neighbourhoods
transporte-publico.html.description: Set your commute rules — how far you'll walk, where you must get to and in how long — and get back the cheapest places that meet them, ranked by €/m². One map of 164 zones: 91 municipalities plus Barcelona broken down into its 73 neighbourhoods, with the rail, metro, tram and bus network drawn on top. Colour the map by price, rent, mortgage, travel time or any of thirteen official indicators — household income, average age, unemployment, higher education, share of foreign nationals, inequality and more — and see every zone's cost plotted against its door-to-door travel time. Times routed over official timetables; click any point on the map for an estimate.

sp500-rendimientos.html.title: Does the S&P 500 Really Return 10 % a Year?
sp500-rendimientos.html.description: 155 years of monthly data put the claim to the test: every calendar year, every rolling window, lump sum or monthly contributions, inflation stripped out and costs subtracted — next to gold, US housing and world equities. Shiller, FRED, Eurostat and S&P sources, nothing estimated.
